mentions.name: Chorebound
mentions.description: An RPG-style chore and habit app where real-world chores become quests: users fight monsters, get loot drops, earn XP and gold, and level up. It supports solo play or co-op with friends and family, and is built to be more lightweight and simplified than Habitica, focused on close-knit co-op rather than public guilds.
mentions.problem: Aimed at people who tried Habitica and bounced off, offering a simpler, more lightweight habit-gamification experience focused on small groups instead of public guilds.
mentions.audience: People who want to gamify chores and habits, playing solo or co-op with friends/family
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Chorebound - an RPG-style chore/habit app. You do real-world chores, they become quests, you fight monsters, get loot drops, earn XP/gold, and level up. Can be solo or co-op with friends/family.
